title: Change shooting mode (P/S/A/M)

steps.text: Hold the mode dial lock release (center of the dial)
Rotate to A (you pick aperture), S (you pick shutter), or M (you pick both)
In A, the front dial sets aperture; in S, the rear dial sets shutter; in M, both

tip: A-mode is the default field mode: control depth, let the camera chase the light.
